description: This file contains utility functions and constants for parsing command-line arguments related to test execution options, including defining sets of flags, parsing arguments into filters and options, and counting/extracting filters from a given set of command-line arguments.

methods.name: parsePassthroughArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into file filters and option arguments, handling special cases like '--' and flags that require values.

methods.name: countExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Counts the number of explicit file filters in the provided command-line arguments.

methods.name: getExplicitEntryFilters
methods.description: Extracts and returns the list of explicit file filters from the provided command-line arguments.
